changelog: Agent discoverability: SKILL.md now states up top that newsflash.sh is a hosted service (a domain, not a shell script — no local binary or MCP process to install) with a one-line curl verification; description now matches 'daily digest' phrasing.
summary: Personalized daily news briefings/digests and real-time breaking-news alerts from newsflash.sh — a deduped news event graph where every event carries a corroboration count and confidence score. Use when the user asks about news, headlines, markets, crypto, what's happening, wants a daily digest or recurring briefing, or wants to be alerted when something breaks.
